typescript.q: How do generics, union types and type narrowing help you model an API response safely? Give an example from your own work.
Explain the difference between interface and type, and when you would use unknown rather than any.

How do you keep types in sync between a back-end API and a TypeScript front-end, and what breaks when they drift?
Explain mapped and conditional types with a practical use case you have implemented.
A TypeScript build takes minutes and the editor lags. What would you inspect to improve compile and tooling performance?
What does the compiler guarantee at runtime, and what does it not? How do you validate untrusted input at the boundary?
How would you design a type-safe event or state management layer that supports many event types without losing inference?

java.q: Explain how the JVM manages memory and garbage collection, and how you would investigate a memory leak or long GC pauses in production.
How do you design thread-safe code in Java? Compare synchronized, locks, atomics and concurrent collections with an example of when you used each.

What are the differences between checked and unchecked exceptions, and how do you design an exception strategy for a service layer?
How do you test a Java microservice end to end, including contract tests, mocking external dependencies and database tests?
Explain how you would design a resilient integration with an unreliable downstream service using timeouts, retries, circuit breakers and idempotency.
Explain equals and hashCode, immutability and why String is immutable, and the problems you have seen when they are implemented incorrectly.

cpp.q: Explain RAII and smart pointers (unique_ptr, shared_ptr, weak_ptr) and describe how they prevented leaks or dangling pointers in your work.
How do move semantics and copy elision change how you design classes and pass objects around in modern C++?
Describe how you would debug a crash or data race in a multi-threaded C++ application, including the tools you would use.
How do you choose between std::vector, std::list, std::map and std::unordered_map, and how does cache locality influence the decision?
What causes undefined behavior in C++, and what practices or tooling do you use to avoid it?
Explain how you would design a thread-safe producer-consumer queue and the trade-offs between mutex-based and lock-free designs.
How do templates and virtual functions differ as polymorphism mechanisms, and when would you choose each?
What is the difference between stack and heap allocation, and what are the consequences for object lifetime?

sql.q: A report query that used to run in seconds now takes minutes. How do you read the execution plan and decide between adding an index, rewriting the query or updating statistics?

How do transaction isolation levels and locking affect concurrent writers, and how do you diagnose blocking or deadlocks?

When would you use window functions or CTEs, and can you describe a problem they solved more cleanly than subqueries?
What is normalization, and when have you deliberately denormalized and why?
How do you make schema migrations safe on a live system with no downtime?
Explain how you would diagnose and fix tempdb or log growth caused by a long-running transaction.

devops.q: Walk through a CI/CD pipeline you built or maintained, including how you handle build caching, secrets, approvals and rollbacks.
A deployment passes in staging but fails in production. How do you narrow down environment differences quickly?
How do you structure infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible or CloudFormation) for multiple environments while avoiding drift?
Explain how you would design monitoring and alerting for a service so that on-call engineers are paged only for actionable problems.
Describe how you troubleshoot a Kubernetes pod stuck in CrashLoopBackOff or Pending, step by step.
How do you manage secrets and least-privilege access across cloud accounts and pipelines?
Describe a blue-green or canary release strategy you have implemented and how you decided when to roll back.
What is the difference between a container and a virtual machine, and what are the implications for security and resource usage?

testing.q: How do you decide what to automate versus test manually, and how do you keep an automation suite from becoming flaky?
Describe the framework structure you used for UI or API automation, including page objects, test data management and reporting.

How would you design a regression strategy for a product that releases weekly with limited QA time?
Explain how you design API tests beyond status codes, including contract validation, negative cases and authentication.
What is the difference between smoke, sanity and regression testing, and when do you run each?
How do you measure the quality of a test suite beyond coverage percentage?
Describe how you would introduce performance testing into a delivery pipeline and which results should block a release.

general.q: Describe the architecture of the most complex system you contributed to, your specific role, and one design decision you would change today.
How do you debug a critical production issue when logs are limited, and how do you prevent a recurrence?
How do you ensure code quality and maintainability on a team: reviews, testing and standards?
Tell me about a performance bottleneck you found and fixed, including how you measured the improvement.
Describe how you design for scalability and failure handling in a service that must grow ten times in traffic.
What security practices do you apply when building or reviewing a feature that handles user data?
How do you break down an ambiguous requirement into tasks and decide what to clarify before starting?
Explain a trade-off you made between delivery speed and technical quality, and how you communicated it.
